articles.title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
articles.snippet: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

articles.title: U.S.- China AI race heats up as Chinese rivals secure billions ahead of IPOs
articles.snippet: DeepSeek and Moonshot attract fresh capital ahead of planned listings, while OpenAI courts major investors.

articles.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
articles.snippet: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.

articles.title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
articles.snippet: The DIGIT pilot will test distributed ledger technology and onchain settlement for UK sovereign debt, with issuance expected by the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
articles.snippet: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.
